cmd_desktop_agent_display_gone: Cause line of an agent instance on Linux when a display helper dies while Atlas notes its start time.
cmd_desktop_agent_helper_exited: Error of an agent instance on Linux when a display helper ends early. {program} is dbus-daemon or sway, {output} its own log (English).
cmd_desktop_agent_helper_timeout: Error of an agent instance on Linux when a display helper is too slow. {path} is its log.
cmd_desktop_agent_interrupted_starting: Error of an agent instance on Linux: Ctrl-C while the headless display started. {program} is dbus-daemon or sway.

cmd_desktop_agent_json_corrupt.description: Cause line when the record file of an agent instance cannot be read. agent.json is the file name. i18n-allow glossary:agent

cmd_desktop_agent_not_on_windows: Error of `atlas desktop --agent` on Windows only.
cmd_desktop_agent_runtime_dir: Error of an agent instance on Linux when the display folder would be the caller's own runtime dir. {path} is that folder.
cmd_desktop_agent_tool_missing: Error of an agent instance on Linux when sway or dbus-daemon is missing. {tool} is the program.
cmd_desktop_bad_install_path: Cause line of an `atlas desktop` install error: the target path has no parent folder. {path} is the target.
cmd_desktop_bridge_bad_reply: Cause line of `atlas desktop debug` when the reply is not valid JSON.
cmd_desktop_bridge_closed: Error of `atlas desktop debug` when the app ends mid-request. i18n-allow glossary:agent
cmd_desktop_bridge_error: Fallback of `atlas desktop debug` when the bridge fails without a message.
cmd_desktop_bun_failed: Cause line of `atlas desktop record` when bun cannot start.
cmd_desktop_command_failed: Error when a system tool used to install or open the app exits with a failure. {command} is the command line, {reason} the tool's own message (English, shown as is).
cmd_desktop_dev_exited: Error of `atlas desktop --dev` when the dev server ends with a failure. {status} is the exit code or signal, already worded.
cmd_desktop_display_mismatch: Error of `atlas desktop --agent` on Linux when a safety check fails before the app starts. {reason} is the check's own message (English).
cmd_desktop_dry_run_silent: Cause line of `atlas desktop --agent` in dry-run mode when the app ended without saying what it would do.
cmd_desktop_ended_settling: Error of `atlas desktop --agent` when the app ends right after its window appeared.
cmd_desktop_exited_early: Error of `atlas desktop --agent` when the app ends during startup. {path} is its log file.
cmd_desktop_gc_instances_kept: Summary line of `atlas desktop --agent --gc`: how many live agent instances were left alone. {count} is the number.
cmd_desktop_gc_removed_path: Line of `atlas desktop --agent --gc` for each leftover store deleted. {path} is the store.
cmd_desktop_gc_stores_removed: Summary line of `atlas desktop --agent --gc`: how many leftover WebKit stores of dead agent instances were deleted. {count} is the number.
cmd_desktop_install_failed: Cause line of an `atlas desktop` install error: putting the new app in place failed. {path} is where it was going.
cmd_desktop_install_rolled_back: Cause line on Windows when a first install fails.
cmd_desktop_installed_version: Success line of `atlas desktop` after installing the app. {path} is where it went, {version} the version now installed.
cmd_desktop_installer_failed: Error on Windows when the silent installer exits with a failure. {status} is the exit code, already worded.
cmd_desktop_installer_no_app: Error on Windows when the installer leaves no app. {path} is where the app should be.
cmd_desktop_installer_wrong_version: Error on Windows when the installed version is not the one requested.
cmd_desktop_instance_exists: Error of `atlas desktop --agent --name X` when X is taken. {path} is its folder.
cmd_desktop_interrupted: Error of `atlas desktop --agent` on Linux after Ctrl-C or SIGTERM during startup.
cmd_desktop_linked_notice: Line `atlas update` prints when the installed app is a link to a dev build and so is not replaced. {path} is the app.
cmd_desktop_linked_to_dev: Error of `atlas desktop --install` when the installed app is a symlink to a dev build. {path} is the app.
cmd_desktop_lock_timeout: Error of `atlas desktop --agent` when the start lock stayed taken. {path} is the lock file.
cmd_desktop_lock_waiting: Line `atlas desktop --agent` prints to stderr while it waits for another instance to finish starting. {path} is the lock file. The `atlas-agent:` prefix is a tag, keep it. i18n-allow glossary:agent
cmd_desktop_move_aside_failed: Cause line on Windows when the old files cannot be set aside before an update. {path} is the file.
cmd_desktop_move_failed: Cause line of an `atlas desktop` install error: renaming the old app out of the way failed. {path} is the app.
cmd_desktop_name_chars: Error when an agent instance name has a character that is not a letter, digit, dash or underscore.
cmd_desktop_name_length: Error when an agent instance name is empty or longer than 24 characters.
cmd_desktop_no_app_in_source: Error of `atlas desktop --from <file>` when the tarball has no app bundle. {path} is the file, {app} the bundle name (Atlas.app).
cmd_desktop_no_bridge: Error of `atlas desktop debug` when the socket does not answer. {path} is the socket.
cmd_desktop_no_bun: Cause line of `atlas desktop --dev` when bun is not installed.
cmd_desktop_no_cwd: Cause line of `atlas desktop capture` or `record` when the working directory is gone.
cmd_desktop_no_debug_build: Error of `atlas desktop --agent` when the checkout has no debug app. {path} is the repo. i18n-allow glossary:agent
cmd_desktop_no_home: Cause line when the home folder is unknown while seeding or cleaning agent instances.
cmd_desktop_no_instances: Output of `atlas desktop --agent --stop` when no agent instance exists.
cmd_desktop_no_menu_entry: Warning after installing the AppImage on Linux when the launcher entry could not be written. {reason} is the cause (English), {path} the app.
cmd_desktop_no_such_instance: Error of `atlas desktop --agent --stop --name X` when X does not exist.
cmd_desktop_not_a_number: Error of a numeric option (--size, --rect) with a value that is not a number. {value} is what was typed.
cmd_desktop_not_agent_mode: Error of `atlas desktop --agent` when the started app has no debug bridge in agent mode.
cmd_desktop_not_appimage: Error of `atlas desktop --from <file>` on Linux for a file that is not an AppImage. {path} is the file.
cmd_desktop_not_atlas_repo: Error of `atlas desktop --dev` outside the repository. {path} is the workspace found.
cmd_desktop_not_installer: Error of `atlas desktop --from <file>` on Windows for a file that is not an executable. {path} is the file.
cmd_desktop_not_your_dir: Error of `atlas desktop --agent --stop` when the instance folder belongs to another user or is a link. {path} is the folder.
cmd_desktop_pkg_missing_binary: Error after a distro package install on Linux when the app is not where the package should put it.
cmd_desktop_rect_format: Error of `atlas desktop debug --rect` with a value that is not four numbers.
cmd_desktop_restored: Warning when an earlier update was killed halfway and `atlas desktop` put the old app back. {path} is the app.
cmd_desktop_run_failed: Cause line when a system tool used to install or open the app (tar, ditto, open) could not start. {command} is the command line.
cmd_desktop_script_eval_failed: Error of `atlas desktop record` when bun fails on the script. {output} is bun's own stderr (English).
cmd_desktop_script_failed: Fallback of `atlas desktop record` when the app reports a failure without a message.
cmd_desktop_script_invalid_json: Cause line of `atlas desktop record` when the script (or its output) is not JSON. {path} is the file.
cmd_desktop_script_kind: Error of `atlas desktop record` for another file type. {extension} is the extension, empty when there is none.
cmd_desktop_script_not_utf8: Cause line of `atlas desktop record` when bun's output has invalid UTF-8.
cmd_desktop_size_format: Error of a --size style option with a value that has no x. Keep WIDTHxHEIGHT's shape.
cmd_desktop_socket_too_long: Error of `atlas desktop --agent` when the instance name makes the debug socket path too long. {max} is the limit in bytes.
cmd_desktop_start_failed: Cause line when the app (or a helper such as sway) cannot be started. {program} is the executable.
cmd_desktop_status_cli: `atlas desktop --status` last row: the version of this CLI. Aligned with the path row by the spaces here.
cmd_desktop_status_linked: `atlas desktop --status` row when the app is a link to a dev build. {path} is the build it points at.
cmd_desktop_status_missing: `atlas desktop --status` when no app is installed.
cmd_desktop_status_packaged: `atlas desktop --status` on Linux when the app comes from a distro package. {path} is the executable.
cmd_desktop_status_path: `atlas desktop --status` row: where the app is. The row is indented and aligned with the cli row below by the spaces here.

cmd_desktop_status_version.description: First line of `atlas desktop --status` for an installed app. {version} is its version, or ? when unreadable.
cmd_desktop_status_version.distinct: product name and a version; the same words in pt-BR

cmd_desktop_stopped: Line of `atlas desktop --agent --stop` for each instance stopped.
cmd_desktop_update_rolled_back: Cause line on Windows when an update fails and the old install is put back.
cmd_desktop_updated: Success line of `atlas update` after the app was brought to the CLI's version.
cmd_desktop_updating: Progress line of `atlas update` while the app is brought to the CLI's version. {version} is the target.
cmd_desktop_version_record_failed: Cause line of an AppImage install when the version file cannot be written. {path} is the file.
cmd_desktop_window_refused: Error of `atlas desktop --agent` when the app declines to show its window. {line} is the app's own log line (English).
cmd_desktop_window_timeout: Error of `atlas desktop --agent` when the app never shows its window in time. {path} is its log file.
